title: process-ipc/v1/token-handshake
description: The single JSON line a parent writes to a child's stdin before closing it. Serialised form is this object + LF, at most 4096 bytes.

token.description: Launch token (Electron main -> backend: 32 random bytes, base64url, no padding) or a derived token (backend -> evidence writer: 64 lowercase hex).

api_port.description: Port to bind on 127.0.0.1; 0 or absent = the child picks a free port.
